value.rationale: The exact symmetry group of the four-point Segre coplanarity condition is a natural invariant relevant to the moduli and incidence interpretation of the determinant. The classification distinguishes geometric diagonal PGL2 actions from 192 discrete components, including unexpected independent Klein-four re-labellings. The maximality assertion is stronger than writing down familiar cross-ratio symmetries; it controls all factorwise coordinate transformations of the eightfold, a useful structural fact rather than an arbitrary parameter slice.
